text:
Maya L.: heads-up — running into a regression from the role-mapping refactor. Some users are being assigned the org-default role when the SAML assertion contains a missing nonce-like attribute (eduPersonTargetedID).
Jon P.: observed this during smoke tests on staging, right? can you paste the failing assertion?
Maya L.: yep. repro steps: login via okta > app > produce SAML. Assertion showing missing eduPersonTargetedID but has email and affiliation. snippet:```xml
<saml:Attribute Name="urn:mace:dir:attribute-def:eduPersonTargetedID">
  <!-- missing for some tenants -->
</saml:Attribute>
```
Luis R.: that attr became required after the last role-policy change. we added a strict match rule in the JIT mapping to prefer epTID over email to avoid duplicates.
Karen (sec): that's risky for federated tenants that don't emit epTID. we should have a fallback.
Maya L.: agreed. in prod we started seeing users landing in the "guest" default role and losing editor/admin rights. impacting a small subset of enterprise customers.
SSO Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-ssomap (priority: P2). Audit logs flag: 12 failed role assigns in the last hour.
Jon P.: logs show a KMS decrypt error on a few assertions:```json
{"error":"kms:Decrypt failed","keyId":"alias/redwood-sso-kms","time":"2026-03-21T15:12:09Z"}
``` might be unrelated but worth noting.
Luis R.: that error aligns with a key rotation we did two hours earlier in staging. but prod KMS rotation was yesterday — ops confirm?
DeployBot: Deploy 2026-03-21T14:05:00Z: role-policy-service v3.7.1 -> promoted to prod.
Maya L.: repro on a prod user: assertion contains `eduPersonScopedAffiliation` and `email`, but our mapping expression is `if(epTID != null) { map by epTID } else { fail }`. that's the bug. should be `else { map by email_verified ? email : fallback_role }`.
Karen (sec): we need an immediate mitigation: rollback mapping enforcement to prior behavior or add a temporary fallback to email. Which is quicker?
Jon P.: quickest is a hotfix to the mapping config — update the expression in the RBAC mapping table. rollback involves deploy and slower audit. I can patch mapping config and roll forward in 10-15m.
Luis R.: patch + monitor sounds good. also add a soft-logging flag so we capture the assertion payload for the next hour (PII safe: redact names/emails before storage).
Maya L.: steps I propose:
1) Jon patch mapping to allow email fallback (owner: Jon)
2) Ops verify KMS key status for redwood-sso-kms and re-encrypt any affected tokens (owner: Luis)
3) Run audit query to list impacted accounts and notify customers (owner: Maya)
4) Postmortem once stable (owner: Karen)
Jon P.: applying mapping patch now: editing `/configs/rbac/mapping/sql` -> replacing rule. patch:```sql
UPDATE mapping_rules SET expr = '\n  if(epTID IS NOT NULL AND epTID != "") { map_by_epTID }\n  else if(email_verified = true AND email IS NOT NULL) { map_by_email }\n  else { assign_role("guest") }' WHERE id = 'saml-jit-tenant-match';
```
Jon P.: patch applied. restarting role-policy-service...
DeployBot: Restarting service role-policy-service (pod: rp-02)
DeployBot: Restart successful.
Maya L.: testing with repro user... login succeeded and role assigned correctly (editor).
SSO Bot: Audit event: role_assign success for user id redacted (mapping via email)
Luis R.: KMS team confirms no outstanding rotation failures in prod; the earlier decrypt error was transient due to a queued rotation job. they rotated back to the active key and cleared pending jobs.
Karen (sec): please capture timeline: when was mapping changed, when did KMS rotate, when did incident start, and list affected tenants. we need to include in the incident ticket.
Maya L.: mapping change deploy time: 2026-03-21T14:05 -> DeployBot confirms. KMS rotation scheduled: 2026-03-21T13:00 -> completed 13:02 per ops. first failure seen: 15:11.
Jon P.: audit query I ran: `SELECT user_id, tenant, event_time FROM audit_events WHERE event='role_assign_failed' AND event_time > '2026-03-21T14:00:00Z'`. results: 8 distinct users across 3 tenants. saving to /tmp/ssomapper-impact-20260321.csv (redacted).
Maya L.: I notified customer success for the three tenants, sending follow-up with remediation steps and apology.
Luis R.: follow-up actions: add a unit test for mapping fallback logic, add an e2e test for SAML assertions lacking epTID, and ensure KMS rotation hooks validate key presence before marking rotation complete.
Karen (sec): escalate to postmortem. include remediation ETA and customer notification log. mark severity: P2 -> P1 if more customers report.
Maya L.: thanks all. I'll update INC-2026-0421 and close after 24h of quiet. :white_check_mark:
